### Objective:

To build trust and improve customer experience by addressing price discrepancies between the order placed and the Box verified. This will be done by:

* Absorbing price increases due to changes at the warehouse picking stage.  
* Reducing payable/crediting the user if prices drop post-order.

### Current State:

Final prices are confirmed only after the warehouse has packed the items. Price changes can occur due to :

* Manufacturer price updates and batch variations.   
* Pack size changes   
* Similar medicine substitutions in case of out-of-stock medicines

Until now, price differences have been passed to users, leading to dissatisfaction and complaints.

### Solution Scope:

We will absorb the price increase that will be happening due to operational or product-level changes

#### Price variation scenarios:

| Case | Condition | System Action |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Case 1 | No price change | No action |
| Case 2 | Price increased | Absorb cost |
| Case 3 | Price decreased | Refund to wallet/payment, Reduced bill |
| Exception | Substitution based on the user adding, changing meds at the HA/Doc call stage | No cost absorption, as it is user-driven |

#### Communication Strategy:

| Order Stage | Price Variability | Theme | Metric Targeted |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Order Summary | Either Price Increases or Decreases | Assurance that any price changes will be on us | Conversion |
| Order Status/My Order | Price Increases | Delight that even though the price was increased, we took care of it for you | Repeat Purchase Rate |
| Order Status/My Order | Price Decreases | Delight/trust  that we always strive to find the best and affordable medicines for users | Repeat Purchase Rate |

**Multi-Batch Price Change Scenario \[Updated 30th Sept\]**

* New Batch Price is higher compared to the locked Price  
  * Individual Item-batch level information with Qty impacted, Initial SP, Final SP, and Cost absorption value to be shown in the list where modification has occurred  
* New batches have a lower price compared to the locked price  
  * Individual Item-batch level information with Qty impacted, Initial SP, Final SP, and Savings due to MRP reduction to be shown in the list where modification has occurred  
* One of the New batch have a higher price, and the  other has a lower price compared to   
  * The batches with Price Increase will be shown in Price Lock Savings  
  * The batches with Price Decrease  will be shown in Price Decrease

#### Experimentation Setup:

We want to run an experiment to test the impact of delight-related elements on the app for the cost absorption feature.   
Experiment Details:

* Experiment Name: CostAbsorption  
* Experiment type: FE  
* Variants  
  * A variant \- Control \- Existing Behaviour  
  * B variant \- Pricelock and cost absorption  
  * C variant \- cost absorption only with bill deduction for cost absorption  
* Split: 33:33:33
